text:
Eloise (CS): Heads-up: enterprise tenant 'helios' goes live tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need a tiny kickstart cheatsheet CSMs can run in under 8 minutes: prefill probes, warm pool, jitter/retries, batching hints, streaming fallback, and a single renewal_risk rule. Prefer copy/paste snippets.
Marco (Solutions): I can draft a 6-checkbox cheatsheet + curl + python snippet + telemetry example.
Eloise (CS): Make sure survey_sent and negative_feedback_count are in the event payload. Also ask customers to tag sample prompts with env=staging/prod.
Rina (SRE): I'll own infra checks and cs-bot alert wiring. Draft checklist: 1) health check 2) 3 prefill probes 3) enable warm pool 30m 4) staged ramp 10/30/100% over 20m 5) observe latency/errors 6) send quick survey at +2h.
Omar (PM): Renewal_risk mapping (single field renewal_risk: low/medium/high): HIGH if any true -> 7d P95 > 420ms OR 1h error_rate > 1.2% OR negative_feedback_count >= 1 OR 24h usage drop > 30%. MEDIUM if any marginal breaches; LOW otherwise. cs-bot DM on high.
Marco (Solutions): Prefill curl (pasteable):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
  -H 'X-Redwood-Prefill: 1'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"tenant":"helios","samples":["Hi, show my recent invoices","Search: latest policy"]}'
```
Marco (Solutions): Minimal Python client snippet (drop-in):
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill',
  headers={ 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  json={ 'tenant': 'helios', 'samples': ['hello', 'show orders'] }
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
Rina (SRE): Healthcheck: GET /healthz?tenant=helios must return 200 before any traffic. Prefill probes: run 3 distinct samples; each must 200 within 2s. Warm pool: enable 30 minutes.
Rina (SRE): Jitter/retry defaults: base=110ms, jitter=random(0..170ms), max_retries=3. Pseudo: `sleep(base + rand(0,170)/1000)` between attempts.
Marco (Solutions): Batching guidance (short): interactive UI -> batch target 4 (max 8); realtime agents -> batch 2-4; async/ingest -> batch 24-64. If tail latency (P95) increases >50% from baseline, flip to small_batch_mode: batch=2 + kv_cache_reuse=true.
Rina (SRE): Streaming fallback: prefer chunked streaming. If connection fails within first 6s or client aborts, auto-retry as sync `generate` with header `X-Redwood-Fallback:stream->sync` and `max_tokens=220`. Emit event `fallback=stream_sync`.
Eloise (CS): Survey we send at +2h (one-line link): "Quick check: correctness / speed / recommend (1-5). Link: https://forms.redwood.ai/helios-postlaunch". Ensure `survey_sent:true` and `negative_feedback_count` in telemetry.
Marco (Solutions): Telemetry sample (single-line JSON we recommend customers/logging):
```json
{"event":"prefill_probe","tenant":"helios","renewal_risk":"low","prefill_tokens":52,"latency_ms":130,"survey_sent":false,"negative_feedback_count":0}
```
Eloise (CS): CSM cheatsheet (6 checkboxes they can tick):
- [ ] Confirm GET /healthz?tenant=helios -> 200
- [ ] Run 3 prefill probes (use curl/python snippets)
- [ ] Enable warm pool for 30m
- [ ] Start staged ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 20m
- [ ] Monitor P95 latency, error rate, usage delta; escalate if thresholds met
- [ ] Send post-launch survey at +2h and mark survey_sent=true

Rina (SRE): Ownership one-liners: CSM = execute cheatsheet & follow-up; Solutions = example snippets & batching guidance; SRE = healthchecks, jitter, fallback & cs-bot alerts; PM = renewal_risk thresholds & dashboard rules.
Omar (PM): I'll wire cs-bot to POST /cs/webhook when renewal_risk==high and also add a dashboard card showing the composite signals.
cs-bot: Alert rule created -> will DM @Eloise when renewal_risk==high :bell:
Marco (Solutions): I'll publish the cheatsheet and snippets under /docs/cs/kickstart-cheatsheets and paste the link here in 2h.
Rina (SRE): I'll add a small health-check script to ops repo and set cs-bot alert. ETA 3.5h.
Eloise (CS): Perfect, thanks team. Once the docs link is up I'll embed the snippets in the kickoff email. Ping me for any missing piece. :white_check_mark:
cs-bot: Deploy preflight -> 'helios' staging checks passed (build 2026.03.789). :rocket:
